about: Wood pigeons, from docs/ideation-track-2/tribes/pigeon/units.json. Ideation track 2; nothing here is decided. 'reminders' lists the display ids whose reminder text the card shows.

cards.name: Sentry
cards.text: At the end of your turn, give this slot +{amount}/+{amount}.

cards.name: Old Campaigner
cards.text: After each fight, earn a Medal. Earn {survived} if this survived. Decorated: Stiff Upper Lip.
cards.golden_text: After each fight, earn {medals} Medals. Earn {survived} if this survived. Decorated: Stiff Upper Lip.

cards.name: Recruiting Sergeant
cards.text: When a slot in front of this is empty in a fight, summon a Private there ({limit} a fight).
cards.golden_text: When a slot in front of this is empty in a fight, summon a golden 4/4 Private there ({limit} a fight).

cards.name: Lance Corporal
cards.text: Order ({cost}): Give the slots in front of this +{amount}/+{amount}.

cards.name: Colour Sergeant
cards.text: At the end of your turn, if this row is full of Pigeons, give its slots +{amount}/+{amount}.

cards.name: Padre
cards.text: After a friendly unit dies, give its slot +{amount}/+{amount} permanently ({limit} a fight).

cards.name: Flying Ace
cards.text: Sortie. After this kills, earn a Medal. Decorated: Cleave.
cards.golden_text: Sortie. After this kills, earn {medals} Medals. Decorated: Cleave.

cards.name: Grenadier Guard
cards.text: Order ({cost}): Make a slot your Guard post. At the end of your turn, give your Guard post +{attack}/+{health}.

cards.name: Lieutenant
cards.text: Start of fight: If this row is full, each unit in it deals its slot's Attack buff to the enemy across from it.
cards.golden_text: Start of fight: If this row is full, each unit in it deals twice its slot's Attack buff to the enemy across from it.

cards.name: Squadron Leader
cards.text: The units in front of this have Sortie and +{attack} Attack.

cards.name: Adjutant
cards.text: After each fight, the units in front of this earn {medals} Medals.

cards.name: Bugler
cards.text: After a Pigeon joins the fight, give your Pigeons +{amount}/+{amount}.

cards.name: Colour Ensign
cards.text: Start of fight: This slot copies your strongest slot's buff.
cards.golden_text: Start of fight: This slot and the slots next to it copy your strongest slot's buff.

cards.name: Wing Commander
cards.text: Sortie. Start of fight: Your Pigeons with Sortie attack immediately.
cards.golden_text: Sortie. Start of fight: Your Pigeons with Sortie attack immediately, twice.

cards.name: Regimental Sergeant Major
cards.text: At the end of your turn, give every slot +{amount}/+{amount}. Buffs you give to slots are doubled.
cards.golden_text: At the end of your turn, give every slot +{amount}/+{amount}. Buffs you give to slots are tripled.

cards.name: The Colonel
cards.text: Units in your hand have Reserve.

cards.name: Field Marshal
cards.text: Medals on your Pigeons are worth +4/+4. Your Decorated Pigeons have Stiff Upper Lip.
cards.golden_text: Medals on your Pigeons are worth +6/+6. Your Decorated Pigeons have Stiff Upper Lip.
